story.title: Truro City game at Folkestone called off after Yassine En-Neyah has medical emergency in warm-up
story.summary: National League South match postponedPlayer now ‘stable and chatting’ in hospitalTruro’s National League South game at Folkestone Invicta was called off after the visitors’ midfielder Yassine En-Neyah had a medical emergency and was taken to hospital.The 26-year-old was transported to the William Harvey Hospital in Ashford for treatment but was responsive on Saturday night, according to an update
